annotation_provenance.source_kind: Checked-in PR97 narrative vault, final snapshot; all dates and authorship are fictional.
annotation_provenance.selection_policy: Before viewing predictions, rank final nondeleted paths in each source folder by SHA256 of geistfabrik-topics-narrative-v1 + NUL + path; take three per folder and retain both template controls.
annotation_provenance.annotation_policy: Required groups describe central subjects using observed wording; acceptable secondary labels remain source-supported. Membership does not establish author stance or intent. Exact-label results remain a limited model proxy.
